newsitem.title: FRANCE: French journalists plan strike on November 14.
newsitem.headline: French journalists plan strike on November 14.

text.p: - French journalists' unions have called a strike for November 14 over government plans to scrap a 30 percent income tax reduction that has been compensation for professional expenses.

The 24-hour strike, called on Monday by six main journalists' unions, will be the second by the profession in the space of a month. It is due to coincide with a National Assembly vote on repealing the tax break, which was introduced in 1934.
Prime Minister Alain Juppe has refused to drop proposals to abolish tax breaks for 100 professions in order to allow a planned general income tax cut for most taxpayers.
